senses.gloss: The symbol "&".
To a limited extent or degree; not completely.
Deeply hurt, saddened, or worried; incapacitated by distress.
belonging to us
Not diluted or mixed with other substances.
A negating expression; an answer that shows disagreement, denial, refusal, or disapproval.
will not (negative auxiliary); used to indicate a future non-occurring action.
Expresses frustration or anger, especially at one’s own stupidity.
(informal) No.

A rich, dense Chinese pastry traditionally filled with lotus seed paste and nowadays with a variety of other fillings, usually eaten during the Mid-Autumn Festival (on the 15th day of the eighth month of the Chinese lunisolar calendar; early September to early October).
To prepare oneself.
The image-making power of the mind; the act of mentally creating or reproducing an object not previously perceived; the ability to create such images.
To star, to contain.
Agricultural labour; husbandry.

A type of drama (a film, play, television show, etc.) that combines elements of documentary and drama, to some extent showing real events and to some extent using actors performing recreations of documented events.
To make a solemn promise (to do something).
movements to music
The activity of taking part in a dance.
(informal) A style of swing dance.
(dance) Of or relating to dancing.
someone who has been winner in a contest
Observant of tradition; attached to old customs; old-fashioned.
Like something from a dream; having a sense of vagueness, insubstantiality, or incongruousness.
A stone milepost (or by extension in other materials), one of a series of numbered markers placed along a road at regular intervals, typically at the side of the road or in a median.
The body of all written works.
(uncountable, collective) A substantial or complete corpus of works produced by a artist, composer, or writer.
(narrower sense) Prejudice, discrimination, hostility or political or religious opposition directed against ethnic or religious Jews or against Judaism; antijudaism; judeophobia.
The use of a single characteristic or part of an object, concept or phenomenon to identify the entire object, concept, phenomenon or a related object.
Of film: freshly processed by the laboratory and not yet fully physically hardened.
Newly produced or obtained; recent.
The collective discipline of study or learning acquired through the scientific method; the sum of knowledge gained from such methods and discipline.
An intensifier, used in the same contexts as fucking, but more intense.
Tired of or annoyed by something [with of].
In need of some rest or sleep.
Tired; weary.
Tired, having senses dulled by exhaustion.
Any weapon designed to be used in biological warfare.
Not able to be traced or tracked down.
Any person who leads or directs.
The part of a computer that is fixed and cannot be altered without replacement or physical modification; motherboard, expansion cards, etc.

(chiefly, _, British, often plural) A removable item in a house or other building, which can be taken with one when one moves out, such as a moveable piece of furniture, a carpet, picture, etc.; US furnishing; compare fixture.
The fashion in which something is organized or arranged.
The objects, other than furniture, that occupy an interior space.
A roller skate with all wheels aligned in a single row along the sole, resembling an ice skate.
A country in Western Europe that has borders with the Netherlands, Germany, Luxembourg and France. Official name: Kingdom of Belgium. Capital and largest city: Brussels.
causing images to appear to move
Of or pertaining to a particular person; relating to, or affecting, an individual, or each of many individuals
Expressing sympathy to someone, especially after learning of a close death.
Unknowledgeable or uneducated; characterized by ignorance.
Lacking knowledge or understanding; uninformed; oblivious.
Having less than an expected standard of familiarity with language and literature, or having little formal education.
A person who is ignorant or uneducated; specifically, a person who lacks appreciation of or is antagonistic towards art or culture, and who has pedestrian tastes.
A totally ignorant person—unknowledgeable, uneducated, or uninformed; a fool.
Unsophisticated, not intended for an audience of intelligence, education or culture.
(literary, also, figurative) Dark and gloomy; obscure. [from 15th c.]
place of worship — see also place of worship
A shrine dedicated to some prophetic deity.
A state whereby several parties share a view or opinion; the state of not contradicting one another.
The state of being settled.
The settlement of differences by arbitration or by consent reached by mutual concessions.
The re-establishment of friendly relations; conciliation, rapprochement.
The unification of something that was previously divided; used especially of a country.
Having a dry, harsh tone to the voice, as a result of a sore throat, age, emotion, etc.
A river in Russia, the longest river in Europe, flowing 2,325 miles through western Russia to the Caspian Sea.
An episode or series of events or circumstances of pastoral or rural simplicity, fit for an idyll; a carefree or lighthearted experience.
To travel through the air, another gas, or a vacuum, without being in contact with a grounded surface.
To remain aloft by means of a glider or other unpowered aircraft.
To remain stationary or float in the air.
A token of praise or respect; something that represents praiseworthiness or respect, such as a prize or award given by the state to a citizen.
A fireplace or pit for grilling food, typically used outdoors and traditionally employing hot charcoal as the heating medium.
(cookware, North America) A device used to broil food; part of an oven or a small stove; known as a grill in British English.
An upright standing or hanging metal bowl used for holding burning coal for a source of light or heat.
A Middle Eastern-style barbecue (cookout), or the barbecue (grill; cooking apparatus) it is cooked on.

Any of various species of New-World passerine songbird in the genus Cardinalis, or in the family Cardinalidae more generally, or of similar appearance and once considered to be related to the former; so called because of their red plumage. (See Wikipedia article for taxonomical information.)
Any of a class of types of cancer affecting the blood cells, especially the white blood cells (usually with massive leukocytosis), and the blood cell–forming (hematopoietic) tissues.
army unit
To secure against loss or damage; to insure.
Not excellent or outstanding, usually disappointingly so.
Mediocre (usually used negatively in modern usage).
Not exceptional; not worthy of special merit, attention, or interest; having no vitality.
large
A person who does not eat animal flesh, or, in some cases, use any animal products.

A comprehensive reference work (often spanning several printed volumes) with articles (usually arranged in alphabetical order, or sometimes arranged by category) on a range of subjects, sometimes general, sometimes limited to a particular field.
(by extension) A similar descriptive list (often alphabetical) of information on other subjects.
One who is politically active in the role of a citizen; especially, one who campaigns for change.
A person who campaigns for a person running for political office or works, or supports, in an organised and active way towards a goal; an activist.
A metal rod, generally of wrought iron, for adjusting the burning logs or coals in a fire; a firestick.
Any of several small, burrowing, insectivorous mammals of the family Talpidae.
Any of the family Bathyergidae of burrowing rodents.
A dark brownish-grey colour, the colour of moleskin.
To ease (a person, person's thoughts etc.) from mental distress; to stop (someone) feeling anxious or worried, to alleviate the distress of.
A country in South America. Official name: Oriental Republic of Uruguay. Capital and largest city: Montevideo.
Difficult to carry, handle, manage or operate because of its size, weight, shape or complexity.
Any carnivorous mammal of the genus Martes.
Any carnivorous mammal of the diverse weasel family Mustelidae, which also includes badgers, otters, martens, mink and wolverines.
The sticky part of a flower that receives pollen during pollination.
A natural elevation appearing as if thrown up artificially; a regular and isolated hill, hillock, or knoll.
A small hill.
(geomorphology) A conical mound of earth with an ice core caused by permafrost uplift, particularly if lasting more than a year. [from 1920s]
A long, slender ship propelled primarily by oars, whether having masts and sails or not; usually a rowed warship used in the Mediterranean from the 16th century until the modern era.
An abnormal blood-filled swelling of an artery or vein, resulting from a localized weakness in the wall of the vessel.
A state of the bowels in which the evacuations are infrequent and difficult, or the intestines become filled with hardened faeces.
Having a low position or a low opinion of oneself; not proud, arrogant, or assuming; modest.
Modest and having no pretensions or ostentation.
Having no additional decoration or embellishment; plain and simple
The state capital and largest city in South Australia.
(geopolitics, historical) Opposing the Soviet Union.
Any of various seabirds of the subfamily Sterninae (of the family Laridae) that are similar to gulls but are smaller and have a forked tail.
The quality of being banal.

Molecules, such as amino acids, sugars, nucleic acids, proteins, polysaccharides, DNA, and RNA, that occur naturally in living organisms; any such molecule, even if created outside a living thing (as for example in a test tube or bioreactor).
A flat fold; a doubling, as of cloth; a pleat.
A wrinkle, fold, crease, or unevenness.

(sewing) A fold in the fabric of a garment, usually a skirt, as a part of the design of the garment, with the purpose of adding controlled fullness and freedom of movement, or taking up excess fabric. There are many types of pleats, differing in their construction and appearance.
Withered; lean and wrinkled by shrinkage as from age or illness.
Courageous.
(colloquial) A delay or wait.
A retardation; a delay.
An act of deferring, a deferment.
Something which is free; a giveaway or handout.
A piece, pattern, or sample, generally of cloth or a similar material.
A fictitious narrative intended to enforce some useful truth or precept, usually with animals, etc. as characters; an apologue. Prototypically, Aesop's Fables.
To determine and declare (property) to be assigned to public use. See eminent domain.
To cook in boiling water.
To join two materials (especially two metals) together by applying heat, pressure and filler, either separately or in any combination.
Any of the many small insects of the order Thysanoptera, especially those that attack useful plants.
A formal agreement between two parties, especially between a church and a state; specifically, an agreement between the Pope and a government.
one-hundredth of a ruble
A true morel; any of several fungi in the genus Morchella, the upper part of which is covered with a reticulated and pitted hymenium.
In a jealous manner.
A key to the symbols and color codes on a map, chart, etc.
(biochemistry) Any of a group of naturally occurring dark pigments, especially the pigment found in skin, hair, fur, and feathers.
A person with a net worth of multiple billions, typically measured in US dollars.
A city, the administrative centre of Mykolaiv urban hromada, Mykolaiv Raion, Mykolaiv Oblast, Ukraine, founded in 1789 at the confluence of the Inhul and the Southern Buh.

A marine mollusc, of the family Nautilidae native to the Pacific Ocean and Indian Ocean, which has tentacles and a spiral shell with a series of air-filled chambers, of which Nautilus is the type genus.
Belief in the existence of at least one deity.
A range; a continuous, infinite, one-dimensional set, possibly bounded by extremes.
The capital city of Libya, originally three separate settlements known as Oea, Sabratha, and Leptis Magna.
A small projection from a membrane, particularly those found in the mucous membranes of the intestines.

(phonetics) Articulated with the pharynx; a term usually describing a consonant which is articulated by the rear area of the tongue being raised to below the region between the uvula and the pharyngeal wall. The term cannot apply to a plosive or stop consonant.
part of the alimentary canal
(anatomy) The narrow passage from the mouth to the pharynx, situated between the soft palate and the base of the tongue.
A Russian district or provincial council, or elective local-governmental administrative division, founded in 1864 by Tsar Alexander the Liberator.
Loose stony debris on a slope.
The science of weights and measures or of measurement.
A sudden movement or gesture of shrinking away.
A chair made for lounging.
A lounger, or reclining beach chair.
An extended deck chair used for sunbathing or relaxing, typically by the sea or a pool.
